svg.title: The evidence timeline for the scrolling-table recording
svg.desc: A 0 to 14 second timeline of a real VSift session on a synthetic recording. Speech from 0 to 7 seconds says order 1017 changes from queued to failed while the header stays fixed. Screen changes are marked at 0, 7 and 10 seconds. The three real frames above them show 1001 QUEUED, 1017 QUEUED and 1017 FAILED in red, with the ORDER and STATUS header fixed in each, and each is labelled with its evidence id.
svg.text: What happens to order 1017, and does the header stay put?
14 s synthetic test recording · real output
“Scroll to Order 1017. The status changes from queued to failed…”
Every item carries an id, a time and a hash tied to the original file.
